item.title: Trump promises Americans $5K if GOP wins. And, Kirk supporters reflect on his death
item.description: President Trump tries to incentivize voters by promising $5,000 to Americans if the GOP wins the midterms. And, young conservatives reflect on the party one year after Charlie Kirk's death.
item.content:encoded:
President Trump tries to incentivize voters by promising $5,000 to Americans if the GOP wins the midterms. And, young conservatives reflect on the party one year after Charlie Kirk's death.

item.title: Trump gives primetime speech at GOP convention, promising payout if Republicans win
item.description: President Trump kicked off the Republican midterm convention with a primetime speech, outlining the Republican message and promising Americans a payout if the GOP wins the upcoming election.
item.content:encoded: President Trump kicked off the Republican midterm convention with a primetime speech, outlining the Republican message and promising Americans a payout if the GOP wins the upcoming election.

item.title: Veteran pollster shares takeaways from Trump's convention speech
item.description: Veteran pollster and political consultant Frank Luntz gives an analysis of President Trump's speech at the Republicans' midterm convention.

item.title: One year after Charlie Kirk's death, Turning Point USA faces an uncertain future
item.description: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. One year later, the movement is wrestling with questions about its future.

item.title: Democrats blast $5,000 payment promise ahead of Trump, Vance speeches in Dallas
item.description: President Trump promised to send every adult citizen $5,000, but only if Republicans maintain control of Congress in the midterm election, drawing a strong response from House Democrats.

item.title: Trump gave Natalie Harp and 2 other aides $45,000 as gifts, report says
item.description: The Washington Post is reporting that the president gave $45,000 cash gifts to executive assistant Natalie Harp and two other White House aides.

item.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
item.description: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

item.title: Republicans kick off unconventional midterm convention in Dallas with Trump speech
item.description: Republicans' first midterm convention, being touted as a "Trumpapalooza" by the Republican Party chairman, kicks off in Dallas with a program focused heavily on tax cuts and border security.

item.title: Andrew Tate is denied bail and will remain in jail during his extradition fight
item.description: Prosecutors told the court that Andrew and Tristan Tate boasted about having multiple passports and flying on private jets. But the Tates' lawyers argued they were only playing a role for their fans.
